name: Test Leg
_note: A hip, a thigh, a shin and a foot, in whole modules chosen so every position in the hierarchy is a number somebody can check by hand. It is a `prop` rather than a `character` because what is under test is the rig arithmetic, and a kind with a slot would drag a stat block into a test about transforms. The bones follow ART-BIBLE §7 rather than the shortest route: each one points down its own -Z, is sized `[thickness, thickness, length]`, and pivots 6 modules along +Z, which is its own top end. That is what makes `rotation` compose down the chain and `Bone.length()` mean something, and it is the case `pivot` was added for.
